book.name: 2a de Timoteo
book.title: Yech mrop kwaan mkee Pab lo Timoteo

content: Tub soldad wen cheen Jesucrist
Wech Timoteo, lu nak mod xgaan na. Tubka nye bzo lo kwaan mzelazh Jesucrist lo lu.
Re kwaan mbin lu mza na kwent lo zyen doo myet, bseeda re xaa nye nzo lo Jesucrist, xaa nzho mod luuya lo stub naz myet.
Noka byelal ded lu re bid mod tub soldad wen cheen Jesucrist.
Nel nik tub soldad nyent mod le xaa stub kwaan, sinka nzhaal le xaa re kwaan nxaal xaa nabeyy xaa.
Nu seeka re xaa ngit, nyent mod le xaa gan tub koron chelee xaa nakit xaa mod nzhaal kit xaa.
Nu noka xaa nkee ngonn nzhaal yilotlaka kayaa yizo xaa lo yalgon cheen xaa.
Tubka le xgab re kwaan nii na lo lu, nu lee Xaa Nabeyy le zee laya yek lu.
Nu nela lu xomod mroban Jesucrist, xaa nak dii cheen rey David. Kwaane nak wdizh chul kwaan nza na kwent.
Nu kwent cheen wdizh chul ne kaded doo na bid, noka axta nzhoo na lozhyib mod tub xaa mbit myet. Per lee wdizh chul cheen Dios nanzhot lozhyib.
Kwaanzee nyedoola na ndeed na bid, zee lee re xaa mleey Dios nzho mod le xaa gan yalnaban, kwaane nak kwaan nzaa Jesucrist, zee nzho mod nya xaa naz leen yiba pa tubka nzho xni.
Wlipa kaza na kwent:

content.text: Chelee be ngut be kwaan lee xaa,
noka ban be kwaan lee xaa;
chelee be tubka yela be ded be bid kwent cheen xaa,
noka nabeyy be kwaan lee xaa.
Chelee be yé be nanlabeyyt be xaa,
noka lee xaa yé nanlabeyyt xaa be.
Chelee be nanakt be nali, per lee xaa tubka nali nak,

content: Xomod nzhaal gak tub xaa chul doo nkee zhiin
Tubka bseed re xaa kwaane, nu kwaan yalnabeyy cheen Xaa Nabeyy guzh lo re xaa, zee nadildiizht re xaa, kwaan nanlet yudar nik tub xaa, nebse nleya zee luux re xaa nkenzhaya.
Tubka bkee zhiin axta paro nzho moda lo lu, zee zo wen lu lo Dios; nel wen nkee lu xchiin xaa, zee natont lu. Nali bzaa kwent cheen re wdizh wli cheen Xaa Nabeyy.
Nakenzhat lu kwent nawlit kwaan yizhyo ne, kwaan nanlet yudar lu. Nel xaa kwaan nzhedizh kwaan zee nebse leya zee masra le xaa re kwaan nawent.
Nu lee re kwaan nawlit kwaan nlu xaa, nxonn mod tub yalyizh nakap doo kwaan le kangren. Nu kwaane nle Himeneo nu Fileto.
Mlaa rop xaa re kwaan wli, nu mbezh xaa lee re xaa Jesús, xaa ngut, ngulola mroban stub welt. Nu sbaa nlux xaa mod ngwii stub naz xaa lo Jesucrist, nu nle xaa zee lee re xaa Jesús nle chop xgab.

Per Dios mzob tub simyent kwaan nye nzob, kwaan nkee re wdizh ne lo: “Lee Xaa Nabeyy nlabeyy rese xaa nak xaa xaa”. [Num. 16:5] Nu noka nkee: “Rese xaa ngwii lo Xaa Nabeyy, laa xaa rese kwaan nawent”.
Leen tub yoo naro nzho yann or nu yann plat, nu noka nzho yann kwaan nak yag nu kwaan nak ban. Lee yann mas nonra nle xchiin xaa gorna le xaa tub yalni, lee stub naza nle xchiin xaa rese mbizh.
Chelee lu nzhul nzo lu lo Dios, lee Xaa Nabeyy le lu mod tub yann non doo kwaan nzho garli xaa, zee listla lu kee lu xchiin xaa.

Bachii lo re kwaan nawent, re kwaan nzhekla re xaa mad le, nu bkwaan re kwaan nali nak, nu tubka bwii lo Jesucrist, nu bkela re myet, nu wen bri kwaan re myet; sbaa nzhaal le lu tubka kwaan re xaa nali, re xaa nzholl lo Xaa Nabeyy be.
Nagont lu re wdizh kwaan nachan nu nagont lu xtizh re xaa kwaan nzhekla dildiizh lo rese kwaan tira nanont, nel nebse dil nyizhal lo kwaan ba.
Nu lee tub xaa nak xmos Xaa Nabeyy nanzhaalt kwaan xaa diizh, mas wen gak xaa tub xaa nadoo lo rese myet, nu nzhaal gak xaa tub xaa nzho mod seed stub naz myet, nkin yedoola xaa ne xaa re myet.
Nu axta nadoo seed xaa re xaa kwaan nayii ne re kwaan wli, zee ne che zle Dios zee laa xaa naletra xaa kwaan nawent, zee wii xaa lo Dios, nu sbaa labeyy xaa re kwaan wli,
zee nzho mod xonn xaa lo tramp cheen Maxuu. Nel nkadoo xaa nkano Maxuu xaa, mod tub xaa nzho lozhyib zee le xaa kwaan nzhekla Maxuu.
